name: Cable Standing Shoulder External Rotation
steps: Stand sideways to an elbow-height cable and hold its handle in the far hand with your elbow bent against your ribs.
Turn your forearm outward until you reach the end of your comfortable shoulder rotation.
Guide your hand back across your abdomen.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your elbow tucked and your chest facing forward.
Let the forearm swing outward only as far as you can keep your upper arm against your side.
